settings.title: Building Skills, Confidence, and a Love for the Game

settings.editor: Our junior program is designed to help young athletes learn padel in a fun, structured, and encouraging environment. With age-appropriate drills and progressive training, we help kids and teens develop skills they can carry for life.

settings.title: Training That Grows With Every Player

settings.editor: Technique is introduced gradually and reinforced through repetition, friendly challenges, and partner drills. We emphasize foundational elements such as grip, positioning, footwork, and rally consistency.
Intermediate skill development, movement training, and friendly match.
Advanced drills, competitive training, and tournament-readiness sessions.
We create a progression-based training environment that helps young players master the fundamentals, understand strategy, and build strong athletic habits.

settings.description_text: Kids learn proper grips, strokes, footwork, and positioning in a supportive environment.
We teach them how to react, anticipate, and make smart decisions on court.
Padel is a doubles-first sport, and our sessions focus on working together effectively.
Coaches encourage effort, resilience, and a growth mindset through every drill.

settings.editor: We accept players from 6 to 17 years old, divided into three age brackets.
Not at all, our program welcomes complete beginners.
Just sportswear, sneakers, and a water bottle. We provide racquets for all juniors.
Give your child the opportunity to learn, play, and build lasting friendships.
